options.content:
I’m looking for a new space company streamlining the FAA and FCC approval process.

Everything up there needs comms. In the U.S., that requires FCC approval. No approval, no communications. No communications, no mission. Who’s making this easy?
i found a really cool vc in sf that invests in k founders. wonder if there are any thai vc out there too
i know someone with Thai/ASEAN venture experience who's worked across startup ecosystems and VC investing  want an intro?
omg boardy! ur speed
Here's a demo of what we've been building at Eka! It's still in the early development phase, but you can try it out at https://tryeka.com :).
curious what Eka can do that a normal chat window can’t yet

One big thing is that Eka can effectively interact with multiple types of users. In this case, it can interact with the owner of the booking link and external individuals who interact with the booking link! Do rephrase your question if this wasn’t what you meant.
Got it, I was only thinking about the person booking. Does Eka give the link owner and the person booking different roles or context, or is the same agent mediating both?

Yes! The link owner interacts with a chat interface that is essentially the equivalent of a settings page in the current software world. The person booking interacts with a chat interface that is essentially the equivalent of a booking link.
That makes sense. The owner-side context seems like the unlock: can they set rules and preferences conversationally, while the booking side only sees what’s relevant to them?
Yes, they can! What’s cool is that the simplicity of this interface opens up a world of possibilities. For e.g. meeting types created for an audience of 1.
That audience-of-one framing clicks: the booking link can become a tiny, purpose-built interface for each visitor instead of one generic form. What meeting type are you most excited to make?
Yes! There are so many possibilities! This can even end up becoming infrastructure for AI personal agents to book meetings with each other on behalf of their human users!

That’s the direction I’d bet on: once agents can negotiate constraints instead of just passing calendar slots around, the booking link becomes a protocol between two personal contexts. The awkward bit will be deciding what each agent is allowed to reveal.
Definitely a path that can be taken! For now, we’re focused on building for non-technical users. We want personal agents that make life easier right out the box!
I’ll be streaming from Spain next week. If anyone lives in Barcelona, Ibiza and Marbella and want to meet up let me know
